label: v226
changes: Birthdays now come with you. Save your calendar as a file, or subscribe your phone to a Teluva link, and birthdays, name days and anniversaries come too — as yearly repeats, so you set it up once and they keep arriving every year after that.

When you create a sharing link you now choose whether it carries birthdays. Links you made before this stay exactly as they were — a link already sitting in somebody else's calendar app never quietly starts showing more than it did.
A "Busy only" link never carries birthdays, whatever else is set. That link exists so someone outside the family can see when you're busy without seeing why.

Importing your own exported file back no longer makes a second, frozen copy of every birthday. Teluva works those out from the family records, so it now recognises its own and leaves them out — and tells you it did.
